capabilities: Lint Markdown files in real time with inline diagnostics
Apply one-click fixes from the hover tooltip
Fix all issues automatically on save
Show the issue count in the status bar
Load rules and style settings from a .rumdl.toml config file
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.1 or newer; distributed via BRAT while the community plugin review is pending. Obsidian flavor is enabled by default so tags, callouts, highlights, comments, Dataview fields, Templater and wikilinks are not flagged; config files outside the vault are read only by the desktop app.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to check notes against Markdown style rules or to fix formatting issues automatically.

relations.evidence: Fast markdown linting for Obsidian using rumdl - a Rust-based markdown linter compiled to WebAssembly.

summary: Markdown linter that shows inline diagnostics as you type and applies one-click or on-save fixes using 50+ rules.
